page.overview:
Who is Sally O'Garee?

Sally O'Garee was the daughter of Phin and Tidjii O'Garee and the sister of Phin Jr., Phaedra, Brie and Koda. She was the narrator of The Wastelander Chronicles.

Sally O'Garee was born on Arrakis to Phin and Tidjii O'Garee. She had four siblings; Phin Jr., Phaedra, Brie and Koda.

Sally and her family were tracking an off-course freighter in the Hagga Basin when their path was blocked by a rock slide. They were then attacked by the Maas Kharet, who accused them of tresspassing on their territory. They attempted to explain that they were just friendly explorers, but the Maas Kharet called them infidels who were defiling the domain of the electric worms. The Maas Kharet prepared to bury them alive, but fled when a Sandworm approached. The O'Garees reached safety on a rock island and once the worm departed, they followed Koda's signal to the Maas Kharet's camp. The O'Garees killed them, took their helmets and Sally found an old map. They then returned to their shop and prepared the helmets for sale.

The O'Garees followed the the map into the Hagga Basin, where they travelled through relentless sandstorms until they reached a testing station where insects were studied. The family hid when a Harkonnen fire team floated down the shaft from above, realising that they had entered a Harkonnen base instead of a Testing Station. As they attempted to escape, they encountered a Harkonnen captain, whom Sally and Koda killed in a coordinated attack. Koda took the captain's ear for his collection and offered to help Sally start her own, but she was disgusted by the suggestion. Once they returned to Arrakeen, Phin presented their findings to Alastair Christian Chim and the O'Garees were rewarded by House Atreides, as the base had been causing them problems for some time and Gurney Halleck had been planning to lead an assault on it.
